out.title: K.K. Maheshwari exits; K.C. Jhanwar becomes Non-Executive Vice Chairman
out.summary: Board approved K.K. Maheshwari's relinquishment as Non-Executive Vice Chairman and K.C. Jhanwar's re-designation from MD to Non-Executive Vice Chairman, both effective January 1, 2027.

person.name: Kailash Chandra Jhanwar
person.bio: UltraTech MD since January 2020; Chartered Accountant who joined Aditya Birla Group in 1981; senior leadership across finance, operations, general management in cement and chemicals.
